sample_unit: caregiver-centered questions (each answered in two sessions and rated by 10 clinical experts)

links.outcome: Reproducibility of ChatGPT responses across two independent sessions (TF-IDF and embedding similarity)
links.effect: Moderate lexical consistency (mean TF-IDF similarity 0.75) and high semantic stability (mean embedding similarity 0.92) across two sessions.
links.quote: ChatGPT demonstrated moderate lexical consistency (mean TF-IDF similarity 0.75) and high semantic stability (mean embedding similarity 0.92).

links.outcome: Expert-rated accuracy and safety of ChatGPT responses on congenital muscular torticollis
links.effect: Mean scores 3.0 accuracy, 3.1 safety, 3.1 overall quality (4-point scale); several responses omitted key cautions, oversimplified, or lacked clinical detail.
links.quote: However, several responses exhibited deficiencies, particularly due to omission of key cautions, oversimplification, or insufficient clinical detail.

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy, safety, and reproducibility of ChatGPT responses to caregiver questions regarding congenital muscular torticollis using expert evaluation without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment intervention.
